Na__Dependencies__ImportMap__Index__.description: Browser import-map targets for all version-locked vendor libraries. Paths are relative to Na__BimAssetTools__App__.html (project root). This file is the SSOT for the import map declared inline in the HTML shell; a browser cannot read an import map from JSON, so the two must be kept in sync by hand.
